questions.text: In which country is the vendor headquartered?
Does the vendor hold a current SOC 2 report? If so, which type and for what period?
How long does the vendor retain customer data after the contract ends?
Within what timeframe does the vendor notify customers of a confirmed data breach?
List the subprocessors (third parties) that process customer data on the vendor's behalf.
Is customer data encrypted at rest? If so, with what standard?
Provide the name and contact details of the vendor's designated security contact.
Does the vendor carry cyber liability insurance? If so, what is the coverage amount?
